title: UG Semester 7 (Session 2022-26) Exam Form Fill-up Dates Released
description: Kolhan University has released the official notification for FYUGP 7th Semester Examination 2026 (Under NEP) for Arts/Science/Commerce/Vocational (Session 2022-2026). Form fill-up without fine: 20 Aug – 31 Aug 2026. With ₹200 late fine: 1 Sep – 5 Sep 2026. After that, daily ₹100 increase (₹600 on 6 Sep to ₹1000 on 10 Sep 2026).

title: Sem 4 Exam Centre Revised — Check Your New Centre
description: Kolhan University has released a revised exam centre list for FYUGP 4th Semester Examination 2025 (Under NEP). Several centre assignments have changed — Karim City College students are now split between J.K.S College (Arts & Commerce) and Jem Foundation Mrs. KMPM Voc. College (Science & Vocational). A.B.M College is no longer an exam centre. Please check the updated list on our homepage or download the official PDF.

title: UG Semester 4 (Session 2024-27) Exam Form Fill-up — Closed
description: Kolhan University has released the official notifications for UG Semester 4 Examination Form Fill-up. The form fill-up period has ended. Last date was 22 Aug 2026 with ₹1000 fine.

title: Summer Vacation Announcement - College Closed from June 10
description: As per the Kolhan University academic calendar, Tata College Chaibasa will remain closed for Summer Vacation from June 10, 2026, to July 05, 2026. However, all administrative operations and exam-related work will continue as scheduled. Classes will resume in offline mode on July 06, 2026.

title: B.Sc & B.A Semester 2 Examination Results Declared
description: Kolhan University has announced the results for B.Sc & B.A Semester 2 (Session 2025-28) Examinations. Students of Tata College can check their subject-wise marksheet on the official Kolhan University result portal. Hard copies of TR (Tabulation Register) will be available in the respective departments next week.

title: Guest Lecture on Career Paths in Higher Education (CSIR-NET/JAM)
description: The Department of Physics & Mathematics, Tata College is organizing a guest lecture on 'Preparation Strategies for IIT JAM, CSIR-NET & CUET PG' on June 05, 2026, at 11:00 AM in the Multipurpose Hall. Keynote speaker: Dr. R. K. Mahato (IIT Kharagpur Alumnus). Attendance is highly recommended for B.Sc Sem 4 & 6 students.

title: Registration Slip Download for UG Semester 1 (Session 2025-28)
description: All newly admitted students of UG Semester 1 (Session 2025-28) are hereby informed that their Kolhan University Registration Slips are now available for download. Please verify your details (Name, Mother's Name, Father's Name, Subjects) carefully. Any discrepancies must be reported to the college counter before April 30, 2026.

title: Revised Syllabus for FYUGP (Four Year Undergraduate Program)
description: In accordance with NEP 2020, Kolhan University has adopted the FYUGP curriculum. The syllabus for Major, Minor, SEC, MDC, and AEC papers is updated. Students are advised to download the latest syllabus from the syllabus section of this website or the university website.
